description: List shipments / delivery notes (weclapp "shipment") — the answer to "where is my delivery": status (NEW, DELIVERY_NOTE_PRINTED, SHIPPED, IN_ROUTE, DELIVERED, CANCELLED), shipping and delivery date, carrier, tracking number and tracking URL, the sales order it belongs to and the shipped items. Narrow with sales_order_id, sales_order_number, customer_id or status. `filters` wird als Abfrageparameter durchgereicht — weclapp filtert nach dem Muster feld-eq, feld-like, feld-gt (z. B. { "name-like": "%Muster%" }). raw: true returns the full records. Read-only.

limit.description: Maximum number of entries to return

raw.description: true = return the full weclapp records

sales_order_number.description: weclapp number of the sales order the shipments belong to

name: list_weclapp_shipments
